item.title: CedarLogic 0.2.3 (build 745) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic Native 0.2.3

  • Fixed: the green window button could start out of place until you clicked the window.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.2.2 (build 744) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic Native 0.2.2

  • Crash reports: the app asks once whether to send a report if it crashes (where it went wrong, never your circuits or name). You can change this in Settings > General.
  • The toolbar's ••• menu (Minimal toolbar) shows its tooltip.
  • The red, yellow and green window buttons are put back in place after moving the window between displays or using full screen.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.2.1 (build 740) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic Native 0.2.1

  • The toolbar works every time. Buttons take every click (even quick or slightly sloppy ones), light up wherever you point at them and show their tooltips. A click no longer nudges the window.
  • The toolbar's empty space behaves like a title bar: drag it to move the window, double-click it to fill the screen, drag a filled window to bring it back to its size. In focus mode the tab strip does the same.
  • Better on battery: while a circuit with a clock runs, the app stops drawing whenever you can't see the window.
  • Export for older CedarLogic: File > Export as V2 (legacy XML)… and Export as V1.x Compatible…, for computers that still have an old version.
  • Split view keys from the classic app: Switch Pane (⌘⌥→) and Close Split (⌘⌥W).
  • Help > Set Up CedarLogic… walks through the settings again.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.2 (build 737) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic Native 0.2

The native Mac app now has the full CedarLogic interface, rebuilt natively (Settings > General > Interface switches back to Simple).

  • A new launch screen, and your last circuit reopens when you start the app.
  • Tabs and split view: drag tabs to reorder (the gap opens where they'll land), down to split the view, or across to the other side. Ctrl+Tab switches tabs.
  • Faster building: drag gates out of the palette, press C while a gate is moving to connect it (Escape takes it back), and see the pin a wire will join.
  • Your work saves itself, with versions kept now and then like Google Docs (File > Version History).
  • Your Circuits (⌘O) and Settings (⌘,) look and work like classic CedarLogic. Every shortcut can be changed.
  • Help (F1): new pages for this app, plus the original CedarLogic Help.
  • Toolbar buttons no longer miss clicks, and the window drags, fills and zooms like any Mac app.
  • Low wires are silver on the dark canvas, easier to tell from the grid.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.1 (build 735) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic 4.0.1 beta

  • Updates now install from inside the app (Help > Check for Updates).
  • New setting: Settings > General > Testing group (Normal or Beta tester).
  • Both Mac apps are here: CedarLogic-4.0.1-mac.dmg (the classic CedarLogic) and CedarLogic-Native-4.0.1-mac.zip (the new native Mac app). First launch: right-click > Open.
